LESSON: WRITING 3.5.1 WRITING NARRATIVE PARAGRAPHS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.5: Writing 3.5.1 Writing Narrative Paragraphs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 3.5.1 Writing Narrative Paragraphs, part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why do we write paragraphs?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 3.5.1 Writing Narrative Paragraphs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Communication is enhanced as the learner composes a narrative paragraph and reviews peers’ work.

 Creativity and imagination are developed as the learner writes narrative paragraphs and shares with peers.

Values:
Respect is promoted as the learner gives feedback on the narrative paragraphs they have reviewed.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Social cohesion is enhanced as the learner presents the narrative paragraph for peer review.

Link to other subjects:

The learner relates the use of digital devices to other learning areas such as Pre-Technical.
